name: Craig of the Creek
description: Craig and his two friends, Kelsey and JP, embark on adventures in the untamed wilderness of the Creek, a place where children can run wild and free. The group of friends solve mysteries, fulfil quests and compete in battles against the other kids.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Craig drops his staff into the sewers after getting distracted by his older brother, Bernard, and his girlfriend, Alexis. He teams up with his best friends Kelsey and J.P. and venture to the Creek to look for it, encountering other strange and wild kids along the way.

videos.title: Craig of the Car
videos.overview: When Bernard dents the family car, Craig takes advantage to get Bernard to do his bidding.

videos.title: How Was Your Day?
videos.overview: Craig talks about his exciting day while eating dinner with his family.

videos.title: The Williams Family Opening Theme Song
videos.overview: Craig imagines the opening theme song to a TV show based on his family.

videos.title: How to Map the Creek
videos.overview: Craig gives a how to on mapping the Creek, but he must also rescue J.P. and Mortimer from a "raging" river.

videos.title: Creek Kids Rap
videos.overview: In a parody of the "Pokérap", Craig tries to name all of the Creek Kids to Jessica, but quickly gets tired.

videos.title: A Behind the Scenes Look
videos.overview: Ever wonder how an episode is made? Go behind the scenes of Craig of the Creek with Philip Solomon (voice of Craig) and the rest of the creek crew!

videos.title: Meet the Cast
videos.overview: Get to know voices behind Craig, Kelsey and JP from Craig of the Creek!

videos.title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
videos.overview: Happy 50th Earth Day! Craig, JP, Kelsey and Mortimer want to show you how you can make a difference in your own environment by reducing, reusing and recycling.

videos.title: Cats of the Creek
videos.overview: Follow the adventures of Craig, Kelsey and JP as they explore the untamed wilderness of the Creek, a kitten utopia in their own backyards. Craig leads his besties on imaginative missions to map every corner of this inspired world full of unoccupied cardboard boxes, scratching posts, mouse hunting, and resident Creek kittens.

videos.title: Stop Bullying Speak Up
videos.overview: Stop Bullying: Speak Up is Cartoon Network's award-winning, multi-platform pro-social initiative that addresses bullying among kids - what to do when you see it and how to stop it before it starts.
